definition: MALLET is a Java "Machine Learning for Language Toolkit".
details: MALLET is a Java "Machine Learning for Language Toolkit".
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. That pattern-earned fluency is Mallet (software project).
